leads.title: Hiring: Automation Developer (n8n, Make.com, GoHighLevel) - full-time, remote from India, INR 9.6-13.2L
leads.description: Nexa Consultancy (Surrey, British Columbia, Canada) is hiring a full-time Automation Developer, working remotely from India. We run our own operations on n8n, Make.com and GoHighLevel, and we build the same systems for our clients: lead intake, follow-up sequences, appointment booking, WhatsApp and email notifications, and reporting that shows what is actually working. What you would do Build and maintain automations in n8n and Make.com Set up and manage GoHighLevel: pipelines, workflows, custom fields, calendars, forms and funnels Integrate APIs and webhooks between CRMs, marketing tools and third-party platforms Build dashboards and reporting on leads, follow-ups and conversions Monitor live automations, catch failures before clients do, and fix them Document what you build so the system stays maintainable Who we are looking for 2 to 5 years building automations or integrations Hands-on with at least one of n8n, Make.com or Zapier. We will train you on the rest Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks and JSON Able to overlap part of your day with Canadian Pacific business hours Clear written English Details Full-time, permanent, fully remote from India INR 80,000 to 110,000 per mont
leads.raw: Hiring: Automation Developer (n8n, Make.com, GoHighLevel) - full-time, remote from India, INR 9.6-13.2L

outreach.subject: Quick idea for "Hiring: Automation Developer (n8n, Make.com, "
outreach.body:
Hi,

Saw your post: "Hiring: Automation Developer (n8n, Make.com, GoHighLevel) - full-time, remote from India, INR 9.6-13.2L". This is exactly the kind of workflow automation work I do.

Here is how I would approach it:
1. A short scoping call to lock the outcome (30 min).
2. A working prototype delivered in 48-72h.
3. Handover with documentation, plus optional ongoing support.

I usually start with a small fixed-price pilot ($150-$500) so you can see it working before committing further.

Three questions so I can quote precisely: what does success look like, which tools are already in place, and what is your deadline?

Reply here or email me and I will send a 2-minute walkthrough of a near-identical build.

Reserve the pilot here (pay and I start immediately): https://paypal.me/7900861
Best,
